propositions: Attested evidence contract enforces provenance of the attestation event but not the measurement context (environment, principal, privilege level), creating escape holes where wrong-environment or overprivileged measurements pass as valid proof

Two real escapes exploited this gap: bedrock measurements from account 579718921998/us-east-2 attested as proof for account 896586841071/us-east-1; live bedrock:Converse calls under bedrock:* identity offered as proof of scoped bedrock:InvokeModel grant

Measurement provenance (environment, principal, privilege_posture, instrument) must be declared in a machine-readable continuation line under each [operator-attested] criterion, converting audit-invisible omissions into explicit reviewable claims

A deterministic check validates presence and shape of the four provenance fields (non-placeholder values, enum membership for privilege_posture and instrument) without judging correctness; an AGENT-tier criterion then checks declared environment against in-repo IaC anchors and validates that non-live instruments cannot prove authorization claims

The mechanism inherits ADR-0043's trust boundary: environment is repo-refutable, but principal and privilege_posture remain author-self-declared; the story closes the undeclared-provenance hole, not the false-declaration hole
